phase: Phase 12 — External Assurance, Production Cloud Closure & GA Gate

gates.name: Release Identity & Provenance
gates.required_evidence: Clean git working tree, annotated tag v1.0.0-controlled-pilot-rc2, deterministic commit hash
gates.details: Verified commit e7db64ce58111a6a5f1bbf6b49d0b3e6dc6fb2db on main branch, working tree completely clean

gates.name: Automated Test Suite Integrity
gates.required_evidence: 100% test pass rate across unit, integration, and security test files with zero failures
gates.details: 80/80 test files passed, 447/447 tests passed (Vitest v3.0.7)

gates.name: TypeScript Compilation
gates.required_evidence: Strict TypeScript compilation with zero type errors or compiler warnings
gates.details: npx tsc --noEmit exited with code 0 and 0 errors

gates.name: SQLite Database & Schema Integrity
gates.required_evidence: PRAGMA integrity_check returns ok, zero foreign key constraint violations, WAL mode active
gates.details: Integrity check ok, foreign key check returned 0 violations, WAL journal mode enabled

gates.name: Adversarial & Negative QA
gates.required_evidence: Rejection of malicious input, SQL injection, XSS payloads, and malformed requests

gates.name: Tenant Isolation & Authorization (BOLA/IDOR)
gates.required_evidence: Cross-tenant resource access blocked with HTTP 404/403, strict organization scoping
gates.details: Cross-tenant test suite verified complete data isolation across organizations

gates.name: Evidence Custody & Cryptographic Verification
gates.required_evidence: Streaming SHA-256 hash calculated at ingestion, time-limited HMAC download tokens
gates.details: SHA-256 hashing verified on all evidence objects; HMAC tokens enforced with 300s TTL

gates.name: Safety Invariants & Zero Autonomous Mutation
gates.required_evidence: Human review mandatory, zero autonomous takedowns, zero live platform mutations, dry-run billing
gates.details: human_review_mandatory = 1, autonomous_takedown = 0, dry-run billing and notifications verified

gates.name: Emergency Kill-Switch & Circuit Breakers
gates.required_evidence: Operational kill-switch returning HTTP 503 and instantly suspending external processing
gates.details: Kill-switch verified via /api/integrations/kill-switch; returns HTTP 503 KILL_SWITCH_ACTIVE

gates.name: Provider API Terms & Scraping Ban
gates.required_evidence: Strict compliance with platform API policies, zero unauthorized web scraping
gates.details: YouTube readonly scope enforced; zero unauthorized web scraping routines in codebase

gates.name: Privacy, Retention & Legal Hold
gates.required_evidence: Two-person deletion approval, legal hold overrides deletion requests
gates.details: Attempted deletion of evidence under active legal hold returns HTTP 409 Conflict

gates.name: Observability & Audit Trail Integrity
gates.required_evidence: Immutable append-only audit ledger with user ID, tenant ID, timestamp, and action detail
gates.details: Audit ledger records all security and operator actions chronologically with zero secret leakage

gates.name: Operational Runbooks & Rollback Procedures
gates.required_evidence: Documented procedures for backup, restore, incident quarantine, and version rollback
gates.details: Runbooks verified in docs/operational-runbooks.md and docs/deployment-rollback.md

gates.name: EXT-001: Independent External Security Assessment
gates.required_evidence: Signed penetration test report and attestation from accredited third-party security firm
gates.details: Scope and RoE package prepared in docs/external-assurance/EXT-001_*.md; third-party assessment has not yet been conducted

gates.name: CLOUD-001: Production AWS Infrastructure Assurance
gates.required_evidence: Live AWS ap-south-1 deployment with KMS CMK annual rotation and S3 Object Lock in COMPLIANCE mode
gates.details: Terraform IaC validated; live AWS provisioning in ap-south-1 requires authorized credentials and human approval

gates.name: SOAK-001: 72-Hour Continuous Staged Canary
gates.required_evidence: 72 continuous physical hours in production canary cluster with zero breaches or unhandled errors
gates.details: Canary plan formalized in docs/external-assurance/SOAK-001_CANARY_PLAN.md; execution strictly gated on CLOUD-001 deployment

gates.name: LEG-001: Qualified Indian Legal Counsel Review
gates.required_evidence: Signed written legal opinion from practicing Indian counsel on IT Rules, DPDP, and evidence admissibility
gates.details: Counsel briefing package prepared in docs/external-assurance/LEG-001_COUNSEL_PACKAGE.md; formal legal opinion pending

blocking_analysis.summary: Software and local staging environments are fully verified and stable. General Availability promotion is blocked exclusively by external assurance requirements (third-party pentest, live AWS cloud provisioning, 72-hour canary soak, and Indian legal counsel review).
